description_en: Queries the databases of a specified Bastionhost instance
description_zh: 查询指定堡垒机实例下的数据库列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-databases --instance-id bastionhost-cn-7mz28f5tk0o --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDatabases

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the Bastionhost instance.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.
For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的堡垒机所在的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page for paging in a paged query. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return on each page for paging in a paged query.  
The maximum value of the PageSize parameter is 100. Default value: 20. If this parameter is left empty, 20 entries are returned by default.
Do not leave the PageSize parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The type of the database. Valid values:

MySQL
Oracle
PostgreSQL
SQLServer
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的数据库类型，取值：

MySQL
Oracle
PostgreSQL
SQLServer
parameters.name: database_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network domain to which the database belongs
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的数据库所属的网络域ID
parameters.name: network_domain_id

parameters.help_en:
The source of the database. Valid values:

Local: local database instance
Rds: ApsaraDB RDS instance
PolarDB: PolarDB instance
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询数据库的来源。取值：

Local：本地数据库实例
Rds：RDS类型数据库实例
PolarDB: PolarDB类型数据库实例
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the host group.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/201307.html operation to query the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的资产组ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/201307.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_group_id

ActiveAddressType.description_en:
The address type of the database. Valid values:
Public: public address
Private: private endpoint on the private network
ActiveAddressType.description_zh:
数据库地址类型。取值：
Public ：公网地址
Private ：私网地址

DatabaseId.description_en: The instance ID of the database

DatabasePort.description_en: The port number of the database

DatabasePrivateAddress.description_en: The private endpoint of the database on the private network, which can be a domain name or an IP address
DatabasePrivateAddress.description_zh: 数据库的私网地址，可为域名或ip地址

DatabasePublicAddress.description_en: The public address of the database, which can be a domain name or an IP address
DatabasePublicAddress.description_zh: 数据库的公网地址，可为域名或ip地址

DatabaseType.description_en:
The type of the database. Valid values:

MySQL
Oracle
PostgreSQL
SQLServer
DatabaseType.description_zh:
数据库类型，取值：

MySQL
Oracle
PostgreSQL
SQLServer

NetworkDomainId.description_en: The ID of the network domain to which the database belongs
NetworkDomainId.description_zh: 数据库所属的网络域的ID

Source.description_en:
The source of the database. Valid values:

Local: local database instance
Rds: ApsaraDB RDS instance
PolarDB: PolarDB instance
Source.description_zh:
数据库的来源。取值：

Local：本地数据库实例
Rds：RDS类型数据库实例
PolarDB: PolarDB类型数据库实例

SourceInstanceId.description_en:
The instance ID of the ApsaraDB RDS instance or PolarDB instance that corresponds to the database.
If Source is set to Local, this parameter is empty
SourceInstanceId.description_zh:
数据库对应的RDS实例ID或PolarDB实例ID。
Source为Local时，该参数返回值为空

SourceInstanceRegionId.description_en: The region ID of the ApsaraDB RDS instance or PolarDB instance that corresponds to the database
SourceInstanceRegionId.description_zh: 数据库对应的RDS实例或PolarDB实例所在地域ID

SourceInstanceState.description_en:
The instance status of the database. Valid values:
Normal: Normal
Release: released
SourceInstanceState.description_zh:
数据库实例状态。取值：
Normal   ：正常
Release： 已释放

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of databases returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的数据库总数量
